summary: Bitcoin Magazine Fidelity Crypto Finally Allows Users to Send and Receive Bitcoin as UK ETP Gains Regulatory Approval Fidelity International has gained FCA approval to offer UK retail investors access to its crypto exchange-traded product (ETP).
